title: Accounts Assistant

Apply Now for Accounts Assistant Role

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Blackpool £30,000-£32,000 Excellent Career Development

A great opportunity has arisen with a long-standing client of mine, a well-established and highly respected Accountancy Practice based in Blackpool, with excellent access to the M55.

They are looking to appoint an experienced Bookkeeper with Accountancy Practice experience to join their growing team.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working with a variety of clients and wants to build on their existing bookkeeping experience within a supportive practice environment, with genuine opportunities to develop their technical skills and progress their career.

The role

Working with a varied portfolio of clients, you will take responsibility for maintaining accurate financial records and supporting clients with their day-to-day accounting requirements.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing day-to-day bookkeeping for a portfolio of clients across a range of sectors.
- Processing sales and purchase invoices, payments, receipts and journals.
- Completing bank and control account reconciliations, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns, ensuring transactions are accurately coded and VAT treatment is correct.
- Managing purchase and sales ledger records and completing supplier statement reconciliations.
- Preparing accruals, prepayments and other journals where required.
- Producing management accounts and financial reports for clients.
- Assisting with year-end accounts preparation, including schedules and supporting working papers.
- Supporting clients with Making Tax Digital (MTD) requirements and maintaining accurate accounting records.
- Building strong relationships with clients, responding to queries and providing practical bookkeeping support.

What they're looking for

We're particularly interested in speaking with candidates who have previous Bookkeeping experience within an Accountancy Practice and are comfortable managing multiple clients and deadlines.

You will ideally have:
- Solid practical bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice.
- Experience preparing VAT returns.
- Good understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and reconciliations.
- Experience using accounting software such as Sage, Xero or QuickBooks.
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach.
- Good communication skills and the confidence to deal directly with clients.
- The ambition to continue developing your accounting knowledge and career.

What's on offer?

£30,000-£32,000, depending on experience, together with the opportunity to join a well-established and respected practice where there is genuine scope to develop and progress.

If you're an experienced practice bookkeeper who is ready for your next step, I'd be very happy to have a confidential conversation about the role and the firm.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join a busy finance team on a full or part-time basis.

This role would suit someone with a background in finance administration, sales ledger, invoicing, or credit control who enjoys working with numbers, maintaining accurate records, and providing excellent customer service.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will support the smooth operation of billing, sales ledger and credit control activities within a fast-paced and growing organisation.

Key responsibilities to include:
- Preparing, validating and submitting weekly and monthly invoices.
- Processing invoices for customers, local authorities and other stakeholders.
- Uploading invoices and claims to customer portals.
- Maintaining accurate sales ledger records using finance software.
- Allocating customer payments and remittances.
- Investigating underpayments, missing payments and invoice discrepancies.
- Producing and managing aged debt reports.
- Chasing outstanding payments and updating management on debtor accounts.
- Processing Direct Debit instructions and BACS payments.
- Liaising with customers and internal departments regarding invoice queries.
- Supporting cash flow reporting and general finance administration.
- Carrying out weekly banking activities.
- Providing departmental cover during periods of annual leave and sickness.
- Supporting continuous improvement of billing, reporting and credit control processes.
- Undertaking additional administrative duties as required.

The successful candidate will have previous experience within Sales Ledger, Credit Control, Finance Administration or Accounts Administration, together with strong Microsoft Excel and spreadsheet skills.

Applicants should be confident using financial or accounting software and possess excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage workloads effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential, as is the ability to work independently and use initiative. GCSEs in Maths and English (or equivalent) are required, along with a fully checkable employment history and an Enhanced DBS certificate or willingness to obtain one.

Experience using Sage Accounts would be advantageous and applicants holding finance, administration or accountancy qualifications are encouraged to apply, particularly those with experience of invoicing portals, contract billing systems and high-volume billing environments

In return the company offers a competitive hourly rate of £13.75 - £14.50, a friendly and supportive working environment and the opportunity to play a key role within a growing and successful organisation.

If you are an organised and experienced finance professional looking for a varied role within a supportive team, we would love to hear from you.
